qs.ours: In respect to what is sinful, God is sometimes said to do what he only permits to be done, and does not positively interfere to prevent; and, though he never tempts men to sin, he may permit them to be tempted to it: hence the suitableness of this petition, in this particular view. Quod igitur dicimus Deo, Ne nos inferas in tentationem, quid dicimus, nisi Ne nos inferri sinas?—" When we say to God, Lead us not into temptation, what do we say but, Suffer us not to be led?"—*Augustine, De Bono Perseverantice,* cap. vi ¦ t I Cor. X. 13. ¦ *t* Matt. xiii. 19, 38; 1 John iL 13,14, iii 12, v. 18.
